article_kids_animals_nests.summary: Birds build nests for four good reasons, and every species has its own design. After reading this you can say what a nest is for, name the parts of an egg, recognise six kinds of nest, and watch birds without disturbing them.
article_kids_animals_nests.title: Why Do Birds Build Nests?

article_science_plants.summary: Every plant starts small and builds itself one part at a time. A seed wakes up, sends down a root, pushes up a shoot, opens leaves and makes its own food from light, water and air. After reading this you can grow a seed and watch each part appear, name the parts of a plant, and explain how a plant makes its food.
article_science_plants.title: How Do Plants Grow?
